title: analytics: a picklist-bound select dimension serves English category labels in every locale — `translateSelectOptions` builds its synthetic field without `picklist`, so `picklists.<name>` translations never apply
body:
Filing gate: **① product defect with reach measured. Class (a).** reach: public door `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`, measured once with a wrong result (English category labels under `Accept-Language: zh-CN` and `ja-JP`).

**Who acts on it:** the objectstack triage seat routes it; the fix lands in `packages/services/service-analytics`. **It blocks objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2000**, the hotcrm acceptance step of objectstack-ai/objectstack#18164, which moves hotcrm's shared option lists onto `picklist` metadata. Found by the `repo:hotcrm` seat's dev, session `session_012zh91QzFgePbkmuHnugLN3`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (hotcrm on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0, `objectstack dev --fresh`)

`POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN`:

| dataset × dimension | hotcrm base `1e88edc1` (inline `options`) | hotcrm branch `3376d3f1` (`Field.select({ picklist })`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `account_metrics` × `industry` | 教育 · 能源公用事业 | **Education · …** (English) |
| `lead_metrics` × `lead_source` | 广告 · 陌生拜访 | **Advertisement · …** (English) |
| control: `account_metrics` × `type` (inline options on both) | 正式客户 | 正式客户 |

`ja-JP` shows the same split.

The same branch serves the same fields correctly everywhere else:
- `GET /api/v1/meta/picklist` and the object metadata relabel per locale, e.g. `industry` `logistics` reads Logistics / 物流 / 物流 / Logística.
- Writes outside the set are refused with `invalid_option`.

So the translation bundle carries `picklists.<name>.options.<value>`, and only the analytics path misses it.

## Read from source (objectstack `origin/main` `959c209d`)

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts`, `translateSelectOptions` (~line 1058), builds `const fields = { [fieldName]: { name: fieldName, options } }` and calls `translateObject(doc, bundle, …)`. The synthetic field carries no `picklist`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` ~3059–3068: for a field, `translateObject` reads `const picklist = typeof def.picklist === 'string' ? def.picklist : undefined` and only then consults `lookupPicklistOption(bundle, picklist, opt.value, opts)`. With no `picklist` on the synthetic field, a picklist-bound field's options fall back to the authored English labels.
- The consumer is the chart and report category labels (`resolveDimensionLabels`). This is the same symptom class #16773 closed for inline `options`, re-opened for the picklist branch that objectstack#19518 / #19519 added afterwards.

**Fix shape (a hint, not a spec):** carry the dimension field's `picklist` into the synthetic field, or pass the field's own metadata, so the resolver takes the same branch it takes for `GET /meta/object`.

**Reach in hotcrm once #2000 lands:** 7 widgets on 4 dashboards (`executive` accounts_by_industry and revenue_by_industry; `crm_overview` lead_source; `sales` lead_source_breakdown, win_rate_by_lead_source and pipeline_stage_by_source; `sales_activity` activity_by_record_type) and 3 reports. Every one would show English category labels in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. Per hotcrm AGENTS.md §2, hotcrm#2000 waits for this fix in a published pin and does not route around it.

## Duplicate check

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed:
- "analytics chart dimension labels not translated for picklist bound select field translateSelectOptions" → 4 hits.
- "picklist option label translation missing dataset query report category English locale" → 4 hits.

None is this defect:
- #5076 (closed `not_planned`) is the pre-#16773 general case.
- #5144 is dotted relationship paths.
- #19518 is the picklist kind itself.
- #7289 and #19955 are other surfaces.
